li.label: worked to the bone
li.description: The council has us working from dawn until we drop. I can't keep this up.

li.label: long hours
li.description: We're up early and in bed late, and the work never ends. The council says it's temporary.

li.label: honest hard work
li.description: We're all putting in long days now. I like seeing the work get done.

li.label: a colony that works
li.description: Long, hard days for all of us. This is how a colony should be run.

li.label: starving on rations
li.description: Half a bowl of mush at every meal. I think about food all day.

li.label: on rations
li.description: The portions have shrunk. My belt has new holes.

li.label: sensible rations
li.description: Eating less now is sensible. We'll be glad of the full stores later.

li.label: living lean
li.description: I like eating lean. My head feels clearer on an empty stomach.

li.label: endless drills
li.description: We have to march and shoot every day. I'm not a soldier, and I hate it.

li.label: drills
li.description: Weapons practice every day. My arms ache and my ears ring.

li.label: good training
li.description: All this practice is making us sharper. We'll be ready for the next raid.

li.label: daily battle drills
li.description: We drill for battle every day now. I almost wish it were the real thing.

li.label: stuck in lessons
li.description: I have to sit still through lessons when there's real work to do. I can't stand it.

li.label: study hours
li.description: Lessons every evening. My head is full and my back is stiff.

li.label: learning together
li.description: We all have lessons now. I've already picked up a few things.

li.label: a colony of scholars
li.description: We all study now. I love talking over the lessons at dinner.

li.label: austerity
li.description: We're not even allowed to ask the council for things now. It's wearing me down.

li.label: tightened belts
li.description: The council isn't taking requests. We make do.

li.label: living simply
li.description: I don't mind going without. It keeps things simple.

li.label: blessed simplicity
li.description: At last we all live simply, the way I always have.

li.label: wasted festival days
li.description: The others are lazing about while the work piles up. It makes my skin crawl.

li.label: idle festival
li.description: The work has stopped for the festival. I can't relax with the chores piling up.

li.label: festival days
li.description: The festival means music, rest and late nights. I needed this.

li.label: best festival ever
li.description: No work, just music and food and dancing. I wish it would never end.

li.label: the council heeded me
li.description: I asked for a decree, and the council actually declared it.

li.label: griped together
li.description: We both hate the decree. Nice to know I'm not the only one.

li.label: argued about the decree
li.description: We had a loud argument about the council's decree.
